<style>
.sim-console{--bezel1:#1a1f1b;--bezel2:#0d110e;--panel:#0a150e;--panel2:#0c1c12;--edge:#2f6b3f;--edge2:#1d4227;--ink:#8ee39a;--ink-dim:#4f8f5e;--ink-bright:#c9ffd4;--amber:#e0b83a;--red:#e0554a;--blue:#58a6ff;--grn:#6fe08a;--lock-ring:15px;box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:100%;height:100%;max-height:100%;overflow:hidden;padding:6px;background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 0%,#171c18 0%,#090c0a 70%);font-family:"DejaVu Sans Mono","Roboto Mono",Consolas,monospace;color:var(--ink);font-size:11px;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:.02em;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
.sim-console *{box-sizing:border-box}
.sim-console .bezel{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;padding:5px;border:2px solid #242a25;border-radius:7px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bezel1),var(--bezel2));box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #000,inset 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.8);overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .screen{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;padding:5px;border:1px solid var(--edge);border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#08120c,#050a07 60%,#07100b);box-shadow:inset 0 0 50px rgba(20,120,50,.10),inset 0 0 0 1px #0c2413;overflow:hidden}

.sim-console .topbar{flex:0 0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(180px,1fr) auto minmax(160px,auto);gap:8px;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--edge2);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0d1d12,#091209);padding:1px 8px;border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .brand{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;min-width:0}
.sim-console [data-slot="system-name"]{height:19px;min-width:160px;display:block;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.10em;color:var(--ink-bright);text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(110,230,140,.35);overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .brand .sub{font-size:8.5px;color:var(--ink-dim);letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.sim-console .statechips{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;flex-wrap:nowrap;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .chip{border:1px solid var(--edge2);padding:1px 6px;font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.10em;color:var(--ink-dim);background:#08130c;border-radius:2px;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}
.sim-console .chip.on{color:var(--ink-bright);border-color:var(--edge);background:#0f2a18;box-shadow:inset 0 0 10px rgba(80,200,110,.18)}
.sim-console .clockwrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:0}
.sim-console .clockwrap .lab{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.15em;color:var(--ink-dim)}
.sim-console [data-slot="clock"]{height:22px;min-width:150px;display:block;padding:0 6px;border:1px solid var(--edge);background:#061009;font-size:15px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--amber);text-align:right;text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(224,184,58,.3);overflow:hidden}

/* ANCHORED LAYOUT: side columns are fixed px, the scope takes every remaining pixel.
   Injected content (interception messages, long track lists) can never widen a column
   or grow a row, so the radar port keeps its size. */
.sim-console .main{flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;display:grid;gap:4px;overflow:hidden;grid-template-columns:74px minmax(0,1fr) 278px 152px;grid-template-rows:minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-areas:"rail scope picture res"}
.sim-console .rail{grid-area:rail;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .scope{grid-area:scope;min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .picture{grid-area:picture;min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .right{grid-area:res;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}

.sim-console .panel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--edge2);border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--panel2),var(--panel));box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.sim-console .panel>.hd{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;padding:1px 6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge2);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#123321,#0b1e12);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-bright);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .panel>.hd .r{font-size:7.5px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--ink-dim);text-transform:none;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.sim-console .panel>.bd{flex:1 1 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;padding:3px}
.sim-console .scope>.bd{padding:2px}

.sim-console .kv{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px;font-size:8px;padding:0;border-bottom:1px dotted #14351f}
.sim-console .kv:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.sim-console .kv b{color:var(--ink-bright);font-weight:500;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.sim-console .kv span{color:var(--ink-dim)}
.sim-console .kv.warn b{color:var(--amber)}
.sim-console .grouplab{font-size:7.5px;letter-spacing:.10em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-dim);margin:3px 0 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge2)}
.sim-console .grouplab:first-child{margin-top:0}

/* range / scale control strip \u2014 live control is rendered into the slot */
.sim-console .rangebar{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;height:19px;padding:0 1px 1px;margin-bottom:1px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge2);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.10em;color:var(--ink-dim);text-transform:uppercase;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .rangebar .zlab{white-space:nowrap}
.sim-console [data-slot="range"]{flex:1 1 auto;display:block;min-width:0;height:17px;overflow:hidden}

.sim-console .scopewrap{position:relative;flex:1 1 auto;display:flex;align-items:stretch;justify-content:center;min-height:0;min-width:0;padding:0;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(72% 72% at 50% 92%,rgba(15,61,31,.55) 0%,rgba(4,10,6,.15) 100%)}
.sim-console [data-slot="scope"]{position:absolute;inset:0;display:block;min-height:0;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;cursor:grab;touch-action:none;overscroll-behavior:contain;-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}
.sim-console [data-slot="scope"]:active{cursor:grabbing}
.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] *{touch-action:none}
.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
/* lock-on / selection marker: tight ring hugging the track symbol only */
.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] .lock-ring,.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] .sel-ring,.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] circle.lock,.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] circle.selected{r:9px;fill:none;stroke:var(--amber);stroke-width:1.2;stroke-dasharray:3 3}
.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] div.lock-ring,.sim-console [data-slot="scope"] div.sel-ring{width:var(--lock-ring);height:var(--lock-ring);margin:calc(var(--lock-ring) / -2) 0 0 calc(var(--lock-ring) / -2);border:1px dashed var(--amber);border-radius:50%;background:none}
.sim-console .scopefoot{flex:0 0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:0 6px;height:12px;padding-top:1px;border-top:1px solid var(--edge2);font-size:8px;color:var(--ink-dim);letter-spacing:.04em;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden}

/* TRACK READOUT: the injected table owns its own header row. Columns are sized for every
   profile field plus the IFF code the runtime reports for each track; nothing here may
   hide, collapse or clip that column. */
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"]{flex:1 1 auto;display:block;min-height:0;min-width:0;padding:1px;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;font-size:8.5px;line-height:1.15;background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(30,90,50,.07) 0 17px,transparent 17px 34px)}
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;table-layout:auto;font-size:8.5px}
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] th,.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] td{padding:1px 2px;white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-align:left;overflow:visible;text-overflow:clip}
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] th{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.03em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-dim);border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge2);position:sticky;top:0;background:#0b1e12;z-index:1}
/* IFF code cell: force it visible whatever markup the runtime uses, and never let it be
   the column that gets squeezed away. Empty IFF reads as a dash, not as blank space. */
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] .iff,.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] .iff-code,.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] .col-iff,.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] [data-field="iff"],.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] [data-col="iff"],.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] [data-key="iff"],.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] [headers~="iff"]{display:table-cell!important;visibility:visible!important;width:auto!important;max-width:none!important;color:var(--ink-bright);letter-spacing:.03em}
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] th.iff,.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] th[data-field="iff"],.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] th[data-col="iff"]{display:table-cell!important;color:var(--ink-dim)}
.sim-console [data-slot="tracks"] td:empty::after{content:"\2013";color:var(--ink-dim)}

.sim-console [data-slot="resources"]{flex:1 1 auto;display:block;min-height:0;min-width:0;padding:1px;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;font-size:8.5px;line-height:1.15}
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] *{font-size:inherit;line-height:inherit}

.sim-console .legend{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0}
.sim-console .lrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:9px 1fr auto;gap:4px;align-items:center;font-size:8.5px;padding:0}
.sim-console .sw{width:8px;height:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);border-radius:1px}
.sim-console .sw.f{background:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(88,166,255,.5)}
.sim-console .sw.g{background:var(--grn);box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(111,224,138,.45)}
.sim-console .sw.n{background:var(--amber);box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(224,184,58,.45)}
.sim-console .sw.h{background:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(224,85,74,.5)}
.sim-console .lrow b{font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-bright)}
.sim-console .lrow em{font-style:normal;font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--ink-dim);text-transform:uppercase}

.sim-console .footer{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .decision{flex:0 0 auto}
.sim-console .decision>.bd{gap:1px;padding:1px 4px 2px}
.sim-console .seqhint{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;flex-wrap:nowrap;gap:6px;font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--ink-dim);text-transform:uppercase;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap}
.sim-console .seqhint u{text-decoration:none;border:0;padding:0;background:none}
.sim-console .seqhint u.ammo{color:#c9b26a}
/* engagement control: compact type so every control \u2014 interceptor band select,
   launcher select, magazine / reload and the fire command \u2014 fits without a scroller */
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"]{display:block;flex:0 0 auto;height:106px;padding:1px;overflow:hidden;font-size:8.5px;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:.02em}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] *{font-size:inherit;line-height:inherit;max-width:100%}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] select,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] input,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] label,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] a{font-family:inherit;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.03em;padding:1px 5px;line-height:1.15;min-height:0;min-width:0;border-radius:2px}
/* every ordinary control in the panel reads as subdued green chrome, so the fire command
   is the only thing on the row that shouts */
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button{color:var(--ink);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#12301c,#0a1710);border:1px solid var(--edge2)}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-pressed="true"],.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.active,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.selected,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.on{color:#04170a;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8fe6a2,#4fae66);border-color:#b6ffc8}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] h1,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] h2,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] h3,.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] h4{font-size:8px;margin:0;letter-spacing:.07em}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] svg{max-height:30px}
/* interceptor band / magazine selectors (long \u00b7 medium \u00b7 short): clear segmented look */
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="interceptor" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="band" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="long" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="medium" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="short" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="launcher" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="interceptor" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="magazine" i][data-action*="select" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-role*="interceptor" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-band],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[value*="long" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[value*="medium" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[value*="short" i]{font-size:8.5px!important;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:2px 7px!important;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(140,240,170,.10)}
/* FIRE / LAUNCH command: the one exclusive red control on the console */
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.fire,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.engage,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.launch,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.btn-fire,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button.danger,
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="fire" i]:not([class*="cease" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="engage" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="launch" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[id*="fire" i]:not([id*="cease" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[id*="engage" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[id*="launch" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[name*="fire" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[value*="fire" i]:not([value*="cease" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[value*="launch" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="fire" i]:not([data-action*="cease" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="engage" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="launch" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-role*="fire" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-label*="fire" i]:not([aria-label*="cease" i]),
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-label*="launch" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] [role="button"][class*="fire" i]{font-size:15px!important;font-weight:800!important;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:6px 22px!important;color:#fff4f1!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ff7a68,#8e1710 68%,#63100b)!important;border:2px solid #ffb0a3!important;border-radius:3px!important;box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(240,70,55,.65),0 0 46px rgba(240,70,55,.30),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35)!important;text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
/* cease fire stays a subdued amber so it cannot be mistaken for the fire command */
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="cease" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[id*="cease" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="cease" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[value*="cease" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-label*="cease" i]{font-size:8.5px!important;font-weight:600!important;padding:2px 8px!important;color:#f0dca0!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#3a2f10,#221a08)!important;border:1px solid #7a6420!important;box-shadow:none!important;text-shadow:none;letter-spacing:.08em}
/* reload / magazine-change command: clearly present, clearly not FIRE */
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="reload" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="rearm" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="magazine" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[class*="resupply" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[id*="reload" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[id*="rearm" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[id*="magazine" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="reload" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="rearm" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[data-action*="magazine" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[value*="reload" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-label*="reload" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-label*="rearm" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"] button[aria-label*="magazine" i]{font-size:9.5px!important;font-weight:700!important;letter-spacing:.10em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 12px!important;color:#04170a!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8fe6a2,#3f9a58)!important;border:1px solid #b6ffc8!important;box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(111,224,138,.35),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25)!important;text-shadow:none}
/* the same hooks inside the resources panel, so a magazine control rendered there reads alike */
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button,
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] select{font-family:inherit;font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.04em;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:2px;color:var(--ink);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#12301c,#0a1710);border:1px solid var(--edge2)}
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button[class*="reload" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button[class*="rearm" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button[class*="magazine" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button[data-action*="reload" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button[data-action*="rearm" i],
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button[data-action*="magazine" i]{font-size:9px!important;font-weight:700!important;letter-spacing:.10em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:2px 8px!important;color:#04170a!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8fe6a2,#3f9a58)!important;border:1px solid #b6ffc8!important;border-radius:2px}
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button[aria-pressed="true"],
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button.active,
.sim-console [data-slot="resources"] button.selected{color:#04170a;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8fe6a2,#4fae66);border-color:#b6ffc8}

.sim-console .keyrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:6px;align-items:center;overflow:hidden}
.sim-console .fkeys{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,minmax(0,1fr));gap:3px}
.sim-console .fkey{padding:0;text-align:center;font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.04em;border:1px solid var(--edge2);border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0e2415,#081209);color:var(--ink-dim);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(120,220,150,.06)}
.sim-console .fkey.act{color:#04170a;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8fe6a2,#4fae66);border-color:#8fe6a2}
.sim-console .fkey.off{color:#27452f;border-color:#152b1b}
.sim-console .plate{padding:0 10px;border:1px solid #4a3f1e;border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#3a3117,#221c0d);color:#c9b26a;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}

@media (max-width:1460px){
.sim-console .main{grid-template-columns:70px minmax(0,1fr) 238px;grid-template-rows:minmax(0,2.2fr) minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-areas:"rail scope res" "rail picture res"}
}
@media (max-width:1080px){
.sim-console .main{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 150px;grid-template-rows:minmax(0,2.2fr) minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-areas:"scope res" "picture res"}
.sim-console .rail{display:none}
}
@media (max-height:640px){
.sim-console .footer .keyrow{display:none}
.sim-console [data-slot="decision"]{height:92px}
}
</style>

<div class="sim-console">
 <div class="bezel">
  <div class="screen">

   <div class="topbar">
    <div class="brand">
     <div data-slot="system-name"></div>
     <div class="sub">Air Defence Operator Console · Fixed 120° Sector</div>
    </div>
    <div class="statechips">
     <div class="chip on">Surveillance</div>
     <div class="chip">Acquisition</div>
     <div class="chip">Engaged</div>
     <div class="chip">Rockets in air 0 / 2</div>
    </div>
    <div class="clockwrap">
     <div class="lab">Mission Clock / TTI</div>
     <div data-slot="clock"></div>
    </div>
   </div>

   <div class="main">

    <div class="rail">
     <div class="panel">
      <div class="hd">Sensor</div>
      <div class="bd">
       <div class="grouplab">Coverage</div>
       <div class="kv"><span>Sector</span><b>120°</b></div>
       <div class="kv"><span>Tilt</span><b>+06.0°</b></div>
       <div class="kv"><span>Limit</span><b>-02/+30</b></div>
       <div class="grouplab">Detection</div>
       <div class="kv"><span>Jet</span><b>150 km</b></div>
       <div class="kv"><span>Helo</span><b>100 km</b></div>
       <div class="kv"><span>UAV</span><b>50 km</b></div>
       <div class="grouplab">Engage</div>
       <div class="kv"><span>Long</span><b>70 km</b></div>
       <div class="kv"><span>Med</span><b>50 km</b></div>
       <div class="kv"><span>Short</span><b>20 km</b></div>
       <div class="kv"><span>Min</span><b>05 km</b></div>
       <div class="kv"><span>Sim</span><b>2 MAX</b></div>
      </div>
     </div>
     <div class="panel">
      <div class="hd">Fire Key</div>
      <div class="bd">
       <div class="kv"><span>Ready</span><b>RDY</b></div>
       <div class="kv"><span>Launch</span><b>LNCH</b></div>
       <div class="kv"><span>Interc</span><b>INT</b></div>
       <div class="kv"><span>Miss</span><b>MISS</b></div>
       <div class="kv warn"><span>Empty</span><b>NO RDS</b></div>
      </div>
     </div>
    </div>

result.design_notes: Layout, palette and furniture stay as sampled from the screenshots: dark bezel (#0d110e) around a phosphor-green screen (#08120c panels, #1d4227 hairline borders, #8ee39a text, #c9ffd4 highlights, amber clock, red hostile), Status strip across the top, narrow left rail of small key/value blocks, big circular scope port left-of-centre, tabular readout panel to its right, a resource/legend column at the far right, a full-width control row above the F1\u2013F12 key strip and the amber caution plate. Profile-driven parts unchanged: TRK/SPD/ALT/TYPE/ID/FIRE STATUS/TTI/PK columns plus the per-track IFF code (forced visible with !important hooks and an em-dash fallback for empty cells), the four identification states with their tones, and the 120\u00b0 fixed sector / 20-50-70 km ring and 2-rockets-in-the-air readouts. This revision (request 7): the engagement slot was made taller (106px, still one flat row) and its typography tightened so the runtime can render interceptor-band (long / medium / short) selectors, launcher select, and a reload / change-magazine button all inside it without a scroller; styling hooks were added so band/launcher selectors read as segmented toggles, reload/magazine reads as a bright green command, and FIRE/LAUNCH is now the single exclusive control \u2014 15px bold uppercase on a deep red gradient with a red glow, while every other button in the panel is deliberately muted green. I did not paint reload or magazine buttons myself, since a drawn-but-unwired control is forbidden: they must be rendered into the decision slot (or the resources panel, which now carries matching styling and is retitled \"Magazines / rounds by band\"), and the step hints in the header are plain text labels, not pressable chrome. Side panels and rail content were shrunk one more notch to give the radar port a little more width and height, and the scope keeps its anchored fixed-pixel neighbours so interception traffic cannot shrink it.
